title: YILDIZ-VPR: A Novel Dataset with Dense Coverage Under Diverse Environmental Conditions for Visual Place Recognition
abstract: arXiv:2608.17033v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Visual Place Recognition (VPR) aims to recognize the location of a query image by comparing it with a set of geo-referenced images. Although many datasets have been proposed for VPR, collecting dense and diverse visual data from pedestrian-level viewpoints is still an important need. In this paper, we introduce YILDIZ-VPR, a visual geo-localization dataset collected through repeated walking traversals on the Davutpasa campus of Yildiz Technical University. The dataset includes outdoor scenes captured at different times of day, seasons, and weather conditions. It contains a wide range of visual content, including historical buildings, modern structures, roads, green areas, and wooded regions. Each video was recorded with a GoPro 9 camera and synchronized with GPS sensor data to provide location labels for the extracted frames. In addition to GPS coordinates, the dataset also includes auxiliary sensor information such as gyroscope, speed

translated_title: YILDIZ-VPR：一种在多样环境条件下具有密集覆盖的新型视觉地点识别数据集
translated_abstract: 视觉地点识别（VPR）旨在通过将查询图像与一组地理参考图像进行比较来识别其位置。尽管已有许多VPR数据集被提出，但从行人视角收集密集且多样的视觉数据仍然是一个重要需求。本文介绍了YILDIZ-VPR，这是一个通过在耶尔德兹技术大学达武特帕夏校区进行重复步行遍历收集的视觉地理定位数据集。该数据集包含在一天中不同时间、季节和天气条件下拍摄的户外场景，涵盖广泛视觉内容，包括历史建筑、现代结构、道路、绿地区和森林区域。每个视频使用GoPro 9相机录制，并与GPS传感器数据同步，以提供提取帧的位置标签。除GPS坐标外，数据集还包含辅助传感器信息，如陀螺仪和速度数据。
tldr: 本文提出了YILDIZ-VPR数据集，通过步行遍历在校园环境中密集采集多时间、季节和天气条件下的视觉图像，并同步GPS及辅助传感器数据，填补了行人视角VPR数据多样性的空白。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces YILDIZ-VPR, a dataset collected via repeated walking traversals on a campus, densely capturing visual scenes across times, seasons, and weathers with synchronized GPS and auxiliary sensor data, addressing the need for diverse pedestrian-level VPR data.
